implementation: Opt-in direct row-major readback eliminates the duplicate reorder matrix. GPU transform geometry, security parameters and RAM/spill safety margins are unchanged.

matched_layout_comparison.memory_note: Direct decoding removes the duplicate reorder allocation. Later proving phases still set the whole-job memory peak; measured peak RAM is not claimed to fall by the removed allocation size.
matched_layout_comparison.promotion: Recommended for new, qualified Linux grouped-eight research runs. Keep explicit layout selection and separate qualification for mixed roots; no production readiness or delivered-transaction claim.

diagnosis.cause: Runner summarize() adds accounting and gpu_process_peak_bytes; the original comparison controller compared the enriched object to raw result.json.
diagnosis.cpu_audit: passed; audit log and root-only artifact hashes revalidated
diagnosis.fix: Reconstruct summary enrichment from preserved accounting and telemetry; require exact equality, zero memory-limit events, and peak memory within the assigned cap.
diagnosis.revalidation: The corrected validator accepts the original real worker artifacts.

matched_layout_failed_attempts.promotion: pending completion and review; direct readback remains opt-in

validation.scope: Configuration, actual execution layout, budget and freshness guards plus a synthetic CLI lifecycle; no hardware timing or proof qualification from these tests.

remaining: Profile adapted FRI, opening, and quotient phases with corrected span filtering; then optimize measured critical-path work.
Mixed depth-six roots, device admission, durable host application and recovery, cold-64/post-seal gates, then the two-hour pilot.

repeated_comparison.order: odd rounds sequential/concurrent; even rounds concurrent/sequential
repeated_comparison.performance_promotion: Keep direct readback opt-in pending matched layout comparison.
repeated_comparison.scope: Two independent eight-wallet subtree jobs per arm. Public wallet proofs are reused; recursive proofs are fresh. This does not measure delivered transaction throughput.
repeated_comparison.timing_boundary: Controller elapsed from each two-job arm start through copying, proving, independent CPU audits and cleanup. No compile/report rendering was launched during the campaign. OS and driver caches were not flushed.

throughput_screen.scope: One exploratory sequential/concurrent pair with four independently CPU-audited roots and fresh recursive proofs. Timing includes complete controller startup, fixture copying, worker execution, CPU audit and cleanup. No performance promotion or delivered-transaction claim.
